entries.sourceBehavior: QRT1 framing and envelopes
entries.targetCanonicalRequirement: SEZ1 1.0.0 with catalogDigest on every response
entries.parityExpectation: framing mechanics remain equivalent after identity normalization; added SEZ1 fields are tested separately
entries.reason: Protocol identity is mechanical, but the SEZ1 envelope contract adds semantics.

entries.sourceBehavior: Requests do not contain authorityGeneration
entries.targetCanonicalRequirement: Every request contains authorityGeneration and the canonical request digest binds it; stale generation is rejected before mutation
entries.parityExpectation: source digest parity is preserved as a fixture while target-only authority-generation tests assert the addition
entries.reason: No honest source parity claim can cover a field that did not exist.

entries.sourceBehavior: One Unix socket and one peer compatibility model
entries.targetCanonicalRequirement: Separate /run/se-z/gateway.sock and /run/se-z/local.sock peer classes; gateway cannot use local socket
entries.parityExpectation: SO_PEERCRED and socket-activation mechanics are preserved; dual-peer dispatch is target-only
entries.reason: A dual trust boundary is not a text rename.

entries.sourceBehavior: 16 MiB frames and a source total-output limit of 64 MiB
entries.targetCanonicalRequirement: Frames remain 16 MiB, but complete stdout/stderr are durable and retrievable without a total-output cap
entries.parityExpectation: offset and byte parity through source limits; target-only tests exceed source limits using durable streams
entries.reason: Frame bounds must not become process-output bounds.

entries.sourceBehavior: 49 installed baby.* operations including one dynamic skill
entries.targetCanonicalRequirement: Changing sez.* catalog published by sez.describe; scaffold declarations must not imply implementation or production support
entries.parityExpectation: every source operation is mapped; only integrated and tested operations may enter an active registry
entries.reason: The target catalog is a canonical specification, not a rename of the installed source count.

entries.sourceBehavior: baby.apply is the authority-bearing scope
entries.targetCanonicalRequirement: sez.root is the only authority-bearing scope; offline_access grants lifecycle only
entries.parityExpectation: scope-validation mechanics remain equivalent after mapping; authority meaning follows target canonicals
entries.reason: Scope identity changes mechanically, but final OAuth metadata and audience integration are 0.1B.

entries.sourceBehavior: OAuth server supports offline_access, refresh families, rotation, and revocation
entries.targetCanonicalRequirement: offline_access requests refresh lifecycle support but confers no operation authority
entries.parityExpectation: rotation, family invalidation, persistence, and revocation retain behavioral parity
entries.reason: Reusable mechanics are already proven and should not be redesigned.

entries.sourceBehavior: Public HTTPS MCP endpoint at baby-quirt.stealtheye.io
entries.targetCanonicalRequirement: No public MCP ingress; primary transport is OpenAI Secure MCP Tunnel
entries.parityExpectation: MCP and auth mechanics are tested on loopback fixtures; no Phase 1 listener is deployed
entries.reason: Tunnel resource identity is assigned by final integration and cannot be invented.

entries.sourceBehavior: One gateway OAuth state root/file
entries.targetCanonicalRequirement: Gateway state under /var/lib/se-z-gateway/ with isolated blue/green slots and backup/restore
entries.parityExpectation: durability and replay semantics are preserved within each isolated test slot
entries.reason: Slot isolation changes the state model.

entries.sourceBehavior: Source components own state according to the Baby architecture
entries.targetCanonicalRequirement: Gateway owns OAuth/transport state; supervisor owns jobs/streams/PTY/artifacts/receipts/replay/idempotency/skills/nspawn/releases/catalog; z alone owns KVM; recovery owns generation/fencing/pointers
entries.parityExpectation: individual stores retain mechanics; ownership boundaries receive target-only integration tests
entries.reason: No component may create a competing source of truth.

entries.sourceBehavior: Some source paths broadly redact secret-looking values from output or errors
entries.targetCanonicalRequirement: Managed credentials are not automatically injected/logged/receipted; explicit owner-authorized raw output remains byte-exact and may contain sensitive data
entries.parityExpectation: managed-credential hygiene is preserved; broad mutation of arbitrary owner output is not final behavior
entries.reason: Unrestricted root cannot honestly promise that raw output never contains secrets.

entries.sourceBehavior: Release/self-hosting mechanics include source recovery and rollback behavior
entries.targetCanonicalRequirement: Recovery is a separately versioned product with independent slots, authority generation, fencing, rollback guard, and state
entries.parityExpectation: stage/verify/transition/rollback metadata mechanics are traced; independent recovery is not claimed in Phase 1
entries.reason: Ordinary product releases cannot share fate with rollback authority.

entries.sourceBehavior: GitHub App verification and ephemeral proof operations only
entries.targetCanonicalRequirement: Generic sez.github.api, sez.github.git, and sez.github.reconcile with explicit write proofs, reconciliation, no token persistence, and no token in logs/receipts
entries.parityExpectation: App identity, installation identity, repository identity, minting interface, temporary HOME/credential helper, and cleanup retain parity
entries.reason: Higher-precedence build scope assigns generic GitHub authority to gateway and control; Phase 2 retains extracted mechanics without active 0.1A registration.

entries.sourceBehavior: Source contains nspawn rehearsal/runner and deployment mechanics
entries.targetCanonicalRequirement: Native nspawn:<id> lifecycle with supervisor as state owner and real acceptance tests
entries.parityExpectation: source command-plan and cleanup mechanics are traced; native lifecycle is not claimed
entries.reason: Rehearsal usage is not proof of the final machine lifecycle.

entries.sourceBehavior: No installed KVM operations
entries.targetCanonicalRequirement: Digest-pinned bundled z is the sole KVM state owner; real hardware-accelerated create/start/exec/reboot/stop/snapshot/restore/delete must pass
entries.parityExpectation: not applicable to Baby parity; target acceptance only
entries.reason: Absent source capability cannot be manufactured as parity.

entries.sourceBehavior: Source exposes job wait/read operations but some caller guidance treats returned jobId as follow-up work
entries.targetCanonicalRequirement: Deterministic server-side wait and resume operations; a job ID is never completion
entries.parityExpectation: job state and wait mechanics retain parity; deterministic request-resume is target-only
entries.reason: Response loss and long work require server-owned resumability.

entries.sourceBehavior: Supervisor requires Node 24.18.0, TypeScript, node-gyp, node-addon-api, and native Linux peer credentials; gateway requires Node >=24.18 <25
entries.targetCanonicalRequirement: Preserve source languages/native implementation until parity; do not silently retain Node >=22 scaffold engine
entries.parityExpectation: exact Node 24.18.0 is used for source and extracted builds
entries.reason: The exact runtime requirement is proven by both pinned manifests and package engines.

entries.sourceBehavior: Exactly one public call_quirt tool with operation, payload, idempotencyKey and no operation enum
entries.targetCanonicalRequirement: Exactly one public call_sez tool with the same exact three-field schema and no operation enumeration
entries.parityExpectation: schema structure is byte-equivalent after name/namespace normalization
entries.reason: This is a proven reusable one-tool mechanic.

entries.sourceBehavior: Source receipts and discovery bind Baby release identity
entries.targetCanonicalRequirement: SEZ1 receipts bind se-z release/catalog identity without claiming independent supply-chain assurance from local self-signing
entries.parityExpectation: signature verification and semantic binding retain parity; trust claims follow target threat model
entries.reason: Cryptographic integrity is not independent provenance.

entries.sourceBehavior: Gateway transports signed requests and owns source OAuth state
entries.targetCanonicalRequirement: Unprivileged gateway owns only OAuth/transport state; supervisor is sole UID-0 execution authority
entries.parityExpectation: sign/forward/verify and OAuth mechanics retain parity; no execution or supervisor state migrates to gateway
entries.reason: Privilege and state boundaries are permanent product invariants.
